ai.no_key: Reading prescriptions needs a Google AI key. You can add one in Settings, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.invalid_key: The Google AI key saved on this phone was not accepted. Check it in Settings, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.key_restricted: The Google AI key on this phone is locked to one particular app or website, so Aarogya cannot use it — typing it in again will not change that. Whoever set the key up can remove that restriction in Google Cloud Console, or make a key without one. You can type the medicines in yourself for now.
ai.api_not_enabled: The prescription reader is not switched on for the Google project this key belongs to. That is fixed in Google Cloud Console, not in Aarogya — switch on the Generative Language API for that project, wait a few minutes, then read the prescription again. You can type the medicines in yourself for now.
ai.offline: Reading a prescription needs the internet. Your photo is saved — turn on mobile data or Wi-Fi and try again.
ai.timeout: Reading the prescription took too long, most likely a slow connection. Aarogya waited and asked again, and it was still too slow. Your photo is saved — try again when the signal is better, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.rate_limited: Too many prescriptions were read just now. Aarogya waited and asked again a few times, and the reader is still holding requests back. Your photo is saved — wait a minute and try again, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.quota_exhausted: Today's free allowance for reading prescriptions is used up. Try again tomorrow, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.quota_zero: The Google project this key belongs to has no allowance for reading prescriptions at all — its limit is zero, so waiting until tomorrow will not change it. Whoever set the key up can switch on the Generative Language API for that project in Google Cloud Console, and add billing details if it asks for them. You can type the medicines in yourself for now.
ai.bad_request: Aarogya could not put this photo into a form the reader accepts. This is a problem in the app, not in your photo. Please type the medicines in yourself.
ai.model_not_found: The prescription reader chosen in Settings is not available for your key. Pick a different one in Settings.
ai.server_error: The prescription reader is having trouble at its end. Your photo is saved — try again in a few minutes.
ai.service_overloaded: The prescription reader is busy. Aarogya asked again a few times and it stayed busy. Your photo is saved — try again in a few minutes, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.safety_blocked_prompt: The reader would not look at this photo. Make sure only the medicine list is in the picture, then try again.
ai.safety_blocked_response: The reader stopped part-way through this prescription and returned nothing. Please type the medicines in yourself.
ai.truncated: The prescription was too long to read in one go and the answer was cut off. Photograph fewer lines at a time, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.thinking_budget_exhausted: The reader used up its whole budget working out what the page said and never wrote the answer. This is a problem in the app, not in your photo — photographing fewer lines will not help. Please type the medicines in yourself this time.
ai.recitation: The reader stopped because the text looked like something it is not allowed to repeat. Please type the medicines in yourself.
ai.no_content: The reader sent nothing back for this photo. Your photo is saved — try again, or type the medicines in yourself.
ai.malformed_json: The reader sent back something Aarogya could not understand. Your photo is saved — please try again.
ai.schema_mismatch: The reader sent back an answer in the wrong shape, so nothing was saved. Your photo is kept — please try again.
ai.empty_result: No medicines could be read in this photo. Make sure the medicine list is sharp, well lit and fully inside the frame.
ai.image_unreadable: This photo could not be opened. Please take it again.
ai.crop_required: Choose the part of the prescription that lists the medicines before it is read. The top of the page, with names on it, never leaves this phone.
ai.cancelled: Reading the prescription was stopped. Your photo is saved.
ai.unknown: The prescription could not be read this time. Your photo is saved — try again, or type the medicines in yourself.

sharing.subtitle: One link, for anybody you want to share your record with.
sharing.warningTitle: Anyone who has this link can see your record
sharing.warningBody: It shows your readings, your medicines and your symptoms. There is no password on it and nobody has to ask you first. Share it the way you would share a key to your house — only with people you would let in.
sharing.noHostBody: There is no web page set up for these links yet, so this is a code rather than something to tap. Send it as it is. Whoever you send it to opens Aarogya on their phone and pastes it in.
sharing.refreshBody: What they see was last sent from this phone. Sending it again updates it with everything you have recorded since.
sharing.refreshFailed: That could not be sent just now. Everything on this phone is safe.
sharing.rotateDisclosure: A new link works from now on. It cannot undo what anyone has already seen. Anything their phone already fetched, saved, took a picture of, or passed on to somebody else stays with them. And it stops everybody at the same moment — every person you sent the old link to will lose it, so you will have to send them the new one.
sharing.rotated: The new link is ready. Send it to everybody who should still see your record.
sharing.rotatePartial: The new link is ready, but this phone could not reach the internet to clear away the old one. The old link may still work until you open this screen again with internet.
sharing.rotateFailed: A new link could not be made.
sharing.notConfiguredTitle: Sharing is not set up on this phone
sharing.notConfiguredBody: Sharing needs a free online project of your own. Everything else in Aarogya works exactly as it does now without it. If you would like to set it up, the steps are below.
sharing.loadFailed: The sharing settings could not be read.
sharing.a11ySend: Send your sharing link to someone
sharing.a11yRotate: Make a new link and stop the old one
sharing.turnOffBody: This phone stops sending anything new. What has already been sent stays where it is.
sharing.turnOffMessage: This phone will stop sending anything new. It does not take back what has already gone — anyone still holding your link can go on seeing your record as it stands today, for as long as it sits on the project. To stop them seeing it at all, make a new link FIRST: that clears away what was sent. Nothing recorded on this phone is touched either way, and you can turn sharing back on later.
sharing.turnedOff: Sharing is off. This phone will not send anything new.
sharing.turnOffFailed: Sharing could not be turned off.
sharing.a11yTurnOff: Turn sharing off on this phone

setup.whatBody: Family on other phones can see your readings, your medicines and your symptoms. They can only look — nobody else can record anything or change anything of yours. Nothing else about Aarogya changes: reminders, records and reports all work exactly as they do now.
setup.stepsTitle: Getting the two lines you need
setup.stepsCost: This is free. There is no card to enter and nothing to pay.
setup.step1: 1. Open supabase.com, make an account, and create a new project. Any name will do.
setup.step2: 2. In that project, open Project Settings, then API.
setup.step3: 3. Copy the Project URL, and copy the key marked anon public. Paste them into the two boxes below.
setup.step4: 4. Once, in the same project, open the SQL editor and run the setup text from the Aarogya sharing notes. Without it there is a link, but it opens an empty page.
setup.openFailed: No browser on this phone could open that page. You can do this on a computer or another phone, and type the two lines in here.
setup.a11yOpen: Open the Supabase website in a browser
setup.urlHelper: It begins with https:// and usually ends in .supabase.co
setup.urlInvalid: The Project URL has to begin with https://
setup.keyHelper: A very long line of letters and numbers. Paste it rather than typing it. This one is meant to be public — it is not a password, and it opens nothing on its own.
setup.keyRequired: Please paste the anon key as well.
setup.pasteEmpty: There is nothing copied to paste.
setup.pasteFailed: The clipboard could not be read on this phone. The two lines can be typed in instead.
setup.a11yTest: Test the connection to this project
setup.workingBody: This phone reached the project and it accepted the key. Sharing can be turned on.
setup.rejectedTitle: The project did not accept these
setup.rejectedBody: Usually the Project URL belongs to a different project, or only part of the key was copied. Copy both lines again from Project Settings, API — the key is much longer than it looks.
setup.unreachableTitle: Aarogya could not reach that project
setup.unreachableBody: Nothing came back, so neither line has been checked yet — nothing is known to be wrong with them. Turn on mobile data or Wi-Fi and try again.
setup.a11yTurnOn: Turn sharing on with these settings
setup.turnedOn: Sharing is on. Your link is ready below.
setup.saveFailed: These could not be saved on this phone.
setup.familyTitle: Family phones need these two lines too
setup.familyBody: A link says which record to open, not where it is kept. Whoever you share with pastes the same Project URL and anon key into Aarogya on their own phone, once.
